rationale: Best runs (AREA 3, ABC buffering+sizing, timing-driven placement, post-GRT repairs, cap213) stall near 8.9 ns, limited at ss 100C by a port path (~-0.55 ns) while reg-to-reg is ~+0.04 at 8.33 ns. Port slack ignored die size (util 30-44) and setup margins, so it looks logic-depth bound; it also scales with the target, so tight-target T_eff is partly optimistic. Hold, slew/cap (0 vs 850) and DRC have headroom. Setting 1 keeps that flow at 8.33 ns but uses DELAY 3 for shallower logic (reasonable here despite weaker flow; DELAY 4 bloated wiring), util 40 for its larger netlist. Setting 2 keeps AREA 3 at 8.16 ns with larger repair margins and stronger slew/cap repair to speed pin nets.
